A few things to know.

How does PriceTracker get its prices?

You record prices as you shop. PriceTracker builds a personal history from your entries, so you can compare against what you’ve seen and paid before.

Can I look up an item by barcode?

Yes. Scan a product’s barcode to record it, then scan it again later to check its price history.

What can I track?

Everyday purchases such as groceries, household essentials, electronics, cosmetics, and supplements.

Where can I get the app?

Download PriceTracker using the App Store or Google Play buttons below. Check your store listing for current device compatibility and availability.
